device_entry.name: 化学气相沉积（CVD）设备控制系统
device_entry.description: 用于化学气相沉积实验装置的工艺控制界面，通常围绕温度与多路气体流量配方进行设置、运行和监控。可在实验中管理配方文件、下发设定值并观察过程趋势曲线，支持薄膜生长等CVD工艺流程。
device_entry.description_en: A process control interface for a chemical vapor deposition (CVD) setup, typically handling temperature and multi-gas flow recipes for run control and monitoring. It is used in lab workflows to manage recipe files, apply setpoints, and view process trend plots during CVD thin-film growth experiments.
